question: Which of the following initiatives was announced by the Union Labour and Employment Minister in March 2022 under the Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maan-Dhan (PM-SYM) scheme?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Donate-a-Pension**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Donate-a-Pension is an initiative under the Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maan-Dhan (PM-SYM) scheme, announced by the Union Labour and Employment Minister in March 2022.
 
• The initiative allows citizens to contribute to the pension funds of unorganized workers, thereby supporting their old-age protection.
 
• This scheme is targeted at workers in the unorganized sector who are not covered under any formal pension scheme.
 
• Individuals can donate the premium amount on behalf of their domestic workers, drivers, or any other unorganized workers who are eligible for the PM-SYM scheme.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maan-Dhan (PM-SYM) Scheme**

 
 
• Launched on 5 March 2019 by PM Narendra Modi, the scheme aims to provide old age protection and social security to unorganized workers.
 
• It targets individuals aged between 18-40 years with a monthly income of ₹15,000 or less.
 
• Beneficiaries receive a monthly pension of ₹3,000 after attaining the age of 60.
 
• Contributions vary depending on the age of the beneficiary, starting from ₹55 to ₹200 per month.
 
• Life Insurance Corporation (LIC) of India is the pension fund manager for the scheme.
 
 
 
• **Unorganized Sector in India**
 
 
• The unorganized sector comprises workers who are not covered by formal employment contracts and social security benefits.
 
• This includes domestic workers, street vendors, construction workers, and agricultural laborers.
 
• It represents a significant portion of India's workforce, with an estimated 42 crore workers.
 
• Workers in this sector often face economic vulnerabilities and lack access to pension and health benefits.
 
 
 
• **Pension Schemes in India**
 
 
• India has several pension schemes aimed at providing financial security to different segments of the population.
 
• National Pension System (NPS) is a government-sponsored pension scheme for employees in the public, private, and unorganized sectors.
 
• Atal Pension Yojana (APY) targets unorganized sector workers, offering a guaranteed pension based on their contributions.
 
• Employees’ Provident Fund (EPF) is a retirement benefits scheme for employees in the organized sector.
